definitions.rwa: An RWA here is a token an identified issuer issues to stand for a real-world asset (a share, an ETF, a bond or T-bill fund, a commodity fund, a credit or fund share), counted only on evidence — Robinhood's registry and the token's code on the chain, or this site's list of other issuers checked on the chain — never on a name.
definitions.value: Value on chain: the token's supply read on the chain times its DEX price — not the company's market value.
definitions.tvl: TVL in DeFi: USD of the token deposited in DeFi apps on Robinhood Chain (lending markets, vaults), from DefiLlama and matched by symbol — DEX pools are counted under Liquidity instead.
definitions.liquidity: Liquidity: USD in the DEX pools on Robinhood Chain holding the token (each pool's whole reserve), from GeckoTerminal; a pool pairing two RWAs is counted once in any total.
definitions.mcap: Market cap: GeckoTerminal's (CoinGecko's) figure — for an issuer on several chains it is every chain's — and never mixed with the value on chain.
definitions.volume: Volume 24h: DEX trading over the last 24 hours in the pools holding the token (GeckoTerminal).
definitions.premium: Premium or discount: the DEX price against the underlying's own price — Chainlink's feed read on the chain, else Robinhood's quote. Stock markets close while DEX pools trade around the clock.
definitions.connected: Connected tokens: tokens with a DEX pool against an RWA (a memecoin paired with TSLA) — not RWAs, listed apart and never counted.
definitions.stables: Fiat-backed stablecoins are listed apart and not counted as RWAs here — DefiLlama and rwa.xyz count stablecoins apart.

notes: Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Robinhood Markets, Inc. No Robinhood logos or artwork are used.
Not advice, never a tip to buy. Do your own research.

How a token counts as an RWA here: it is in Robinhood's Stock Token registry and its code runs from Robinhood's registry on the chain ("confirmed"); or the registry lists it and the chain has not been read yet ("issuer-listed"); or it is on this site's list of other issuers, confirmed only once its own fingerprint is read on the chain. A name or a symbol never qualifies a token.
Stablecoins and tokens merely paired with an RWA are listed apart and never counted.
Ranked by what circulates on the chain (the other rankings do not apply to stablecoins).
Left out, as crypto-backed or synthetic dollars rather than fiat-backed ones (DefiLlama's pegMechanism): USDe (crypto-backed), U (crypto-backed), rwaUSDi (crypto-backed), rwaUSD (crypto-backed).

TVL in DeFi is summed over the apps DefiLlama lists with the largest deposits on the chain (Catch Exchange, Solon Stocks, Morpho Blue, Grove Finance, Spark Savings); DEX pools, exchanges and apps that deposit into other apps are left out so nothing is counted twice.
